name: Emylcamate
summary: Emylcamate (marketed as Striatran by Merck) is an anxiolytic and muscle relaxant. It was patented in the US in 1961 (US Patent 2,972,564) and advertised for the treatment of anxiety and tension. It was claimed to be superior to meprobamate, which would eventually replace emylcamate.

uses.text: Emylcamate (marketed as Striatran by Merck) is an anxiolytic and muscle relaxant. It was patented in the US in 1961 (US Patent 2,972,564) and advertised for the treatment of anxiety and tension. The drug has been encountered online as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 依米氨酯（英語：Emylcamate），由默克藥廠以商品名Striatran銷售，是一種抗焦慮藥和肌肉鬆弛劑。它於1961年在美國獲得專利（美國專利 2,972,564），並宣傳用於治療焦慮和緊張。據稱它優於當時的市場領導者甲丙氨酯。它目前已不再被開為處方藥。
